task_title: Harden abortable sleep() with post-registration re-check

plan_review.notes: Separate-model (gpt-5.4) review of the sleep() abort-race hardening + tests. Verdict: implementation correct, no regression (idempotent resolve; no listener/timer leak; cleanup ordering fine); confirmed the reviewer race is a false positive for the current synchronous executor and the re-check is the right minimal no-deps hardening. 1 non-blocking concern: test 2 did not strictly pin resolution to the POST-registration re-check and regression-failed only via a slow 60s timeout. Resolved: rewrote test 2 to track listener registration (registered/reCheckObserved so only the post-registration re-check can resolve it) and assert prompt settlement via a microtask-sentinel race under fake timers.
